aarti.tek: Śrī Bāṅke Bihārī, I sing your āratī; Kuñja Bihārī, I sing your āratī; Śrī Śyāmasundara, I sing your āratī.
aarti.pad1: The peacock-feather crown shines on the Lord's head; the lovely flute enchants my heart. Seeing this beauty, I give myself to you. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: From your feet flowed the beloved Gaṅgā, who has delivered the whole world; may I have the darśana of those feet. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: You are the protector of your servants and of the helpless; in sorrow and in joy, all through life, beloved, you are with me. I bow my head at Hari's feet. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: You are the beloved of Śrī Haridāsa; my Mohana, you are the treasure of my life. Seeing the beauty of the divine pair (Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa), I give myself to you again and again. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: I sing the āratī, beloved, and delight you. Giridhara, I sing your āratī; Śrī Śyāmasundara, I sing your āratī. ॥5॥
